notes: Gold quoted per gram by karat (21K most popular); the 8 g 21K gold pound is a common coin. Jewelry VAT 14% falls on the making charge, not the metal. Bar premiums are BTC bars at Goldady vs spot at the official CBE rate (about 54.8 EGP/USD). Making charges fell 20-30% as demand moved to bullion (about 70% of sales). Used-gold figure is dealer spread only; making is lost.

sources.name: Egypt Tax Authority VAT Executive Regulations
sources.what: Standard VAT 14%; for gold/silver jewelry the taxable manufacturing value is the invoice value minus the announced per-gram metal price
